name: stock-researcher
description: Comprehensive global investment research toolkit: quantitative analysis and directional forecasting for A-shares, HK/US stocks, funds, ETFs, futures, gold and bonds across 12 global markets. Sector RPS ranking, market regime detection, five-dimension analysis, six legendary-investor council consensus, multi-horizon scenario forecasts, historical pattern matching, earnings report interpretation, AI deep analysis (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Ollama with 7 templates), multi-source data fetching (akshare/Eastmoney API/yfinance/Finnhub), MCP Server with 14 tools, and two-way sync with 12 knowledge-base platforms.

displayDescription.en: Global investment research across 12 markets: AI deep analysis + multi-source data + master investor consensus + MCP Server with 14 tools.
displayDescription.zh: 全球12市场投研：AI深度解读(DeepSeek)+多源数据(akshare/yfinance)+大师圆桌+MCP 14工具，零依赖核心。
